name: Mum
scene: a lit candle with a flame
notes: Small opening-level design; 21 closed coloured panes counted by connected-component analysis and visually reviewed. Seven subject panes and fourteen background panes. Opaque white exterior, portrait 1086x1448. Generated with vitray_lighthouse style reference (vitray_lighthouse.png); one regeneration was reviewed but rejected for 34 panes, retaining the original within the required 12–22 range. Remaining concerns: subtle shading rather than perfectly flat fills; adjacent amber candle top/body panes; crowded or near-four-way junctions along the left candle edge and near flame tips; narrow background wedges at the flame base; candle base touches the outer rim. These require attention during tracing; this is a design sheet, not validated playable geometry.
